messages:
anita: Heads-up — OrionSilicon pilot handshake: got final NDA back from legal. They're ok with our standard Redwood HW preview NDA but want a 30-day embargo on public benchmarks. Can we confirm lab slots next week? :handshake:

mike (hw-eng): Nice. 30 days embargo is fine. Need to validate driver bundle first — engineers need the board firmware v2.1.4. @pj can you reserve 2 consecutive 4-hour slots Mon/Tue?

pj (lab-ops): Can do. Tentatively booked Mon 9-13 and Tue 9-13 PT. I'll lock after devops-bot ticket is created.

devops-bot: Ticket created: HW-4827 — "Orion pilot: driver + bench run" — https://jira.example.com/browse/HW-4827

chris (infra): We'll need kernel patch for mmap fix. Mike, can you drop the patch branch? Also we'll enable `kv-cache=on` in the runtime config for the pilot.

mike (hw-eng): Patch branch is at https://git.internal/redwood/orion-fw/pulls/56 — includes mmap fix + power caps. Bench script updated:
```bash
./run_bench --model orion-1 --seq 2048 --iters 120 --tag pilot-orion-2026
```

julia (product): For marketplace listing: product copy needs to say "preview hardware slot" and include region constraints (us-west1 only). Packaging assets: we'll need 1 architecture diagram and 3 latency graphs. ETA Wed EOD from analytics.

anita: Great — timeline recap: NDA signed, embargo until 2026-05-15, lab runs Mon/Tue, infra to validate kernels Wed, marketplace assets by Wed EOD, public announcement hold until embargo lift. If anything slips we revert to our fallback model (orion-lite) for demo. :thumbsup:

pj (lab-ops): Confirmed — I'll ship a receipt checklist to the group and note who will be onsite. Also pinging courier ops for overnight board delivery.

mike (hw-eng): Quick note — please don't run the full perf fleet until we validate power caps. Start with 4 warmup runs then ramp.

chris (infra): Ok. I'll add a canary flag in configs so we can roll back to v1 easily.

anita: Thanks team — will follow up with a short runbook and timeframe. Meeting to align Tue 10am PT. @julia can you coordinate press embargo calendar with comms?

julia (product): On it — will loop in comms and add embargo date to calendar. :calendar:
